critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 2994 lines — modular refactor still overdue (flagged since iter10). Add routers/ subpackage (ai.py, fleet.py, push.py, auth.py, trips.py).

ai_transcribe returns 503 'STT-tjeneste utilgjengelig' for ANY internal exception (line 1049-1051). This masks real errors (e.g. quota, network, unsupported format). Consider logging + returning distinct 400 for 'unsupported format' vs 502/503 for upstream.

fleet_export_monthly: openpyxl workbook is streamed in-memory but response returns via FastAPI JSON default — verify StreamingResponse wraps buf.getvalue() correctly (works but iter18 didn't inspect that path). File was well-formed, so acceptance passes.

DevNavigator still visible to ALL users on ALL routes (unchanged since iter17). Must be gated behind env flag or admin role before Play Store / App Store review — reviewers will flag test-account UI in production.
translation_cache never expires — cached translations can drift with model version. Add TTL (e.g. 30 days) or version key.

native_push_tokens uses composite (user_id, platform) upsert — a single user can only have ONE token per platform. Multi-device (e.g. user with iPhone + iPad) will overwrite. Consider adding device_id.
